projects.title: House Price Prediction System | AI-Powered Property Insights
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered property analytics platform designed to help users explore estimated UK house prices. A Next.js interface captures property information, a FastAPI backend connects the application to machine-learning predictions, and a PostgreSQL-backed workflow supports structured data handling and actionable property insights.
highlights: Predictive workflow: users enter property information through the web interface and receive an estimated price from the machine-learning service.
AI & analytics: presents prediction results alongside an interactive dashboard to make property-price insights easier to understand.
Backend integration: connects the Next.js frontend to Python/FastAPI REST endpoints for structured requests and responses.
Data management: uses PostgreSQL to support application data workflows and organized backend architecture.
User experience: brings property inputs, prediction results and analytics together in a responsive interface.
Deployment readiness: uses Docker to support consistent setup and portable application deployment.
Engineering focus: separates the frontend, API, prediction logic and data layer for maintainability.

projects.title: Adeyspices & Haipetland | AI-Enabled E-commerce Webshops
projects.description: Architected and delivered modern, responsive e-commerce storefronts and administrative dashboards for Adeyspices and Haipetland—bringing together secure commerce APIs, intelligent agent-assisted workflows, real-time communication, and dependable cloud-ready delivery.
highlights: Agentic AI & automation: integrated AI-assisted backend workflows, defined tools and API-based agent actions connected to commerce services; exploring RAG and LLM orchestration.
API architecture & quality: designed RESTful services and used Swagger for API documentation and testing, with an emphasis on reliability and maintainability.
Real-time engagement: integrated WebSockets to support live chat and responsive customer interactions.
Secure commerce: developed Stripe and PayPal payment integrations and administration workflows.
Experience-led UI/UX: delivered professional, mobile-responsive Next.js/React storefronts and dashboards.
Agile leadership: coordinated delivery with Trello, Scrum practices, reviews and iterative milestones.
DevOps & deployment: automated delivery through GitLab CI/CD and used Docker to support consistent deployment.
Cross-platform engineering: built Flutter/Dart mobile application features to extend accessibility.

projects.title: College Human Resource & Inventory Management System
projects.description: Engineered an integrated college administration solution connecting human-resource operations with inventory management. Built with Laravel and Vue.js, the system brings essential administrative workflows into a cohesive, responsive experience, with an emphasis on clean API contracts, maintainable architecture and dependable data handling.
highlights: Unified college HR and inventory workflows in one application, simplifying how administrative teams access and manage operational information.
Developed Laravel/PHP backend services and Vue.js interfaces with a focus on readable code, modular components and responsive user experiences.
Applied RESTful API design principles and GraphQL-oriented API capabilities to support structured access to application data.
Used Swagger / OpenAPI documentation and API testing practices to clarify endpoints, validate integrations and support reliable maintenance.
Emphasized input validation, controlled data access, clear error handling and reusable application logic.

projects.title: Court Case Management & Decision-Support System
projects.description: Developed a court-focused digital case-management platform using Laravel/PHP and Vue.js to simplify administrative workflows, organize case information and help court personnel access relevant records for timely, informed decisions. Designed to support human decision-making—not replace judicial judgment—with an emphasis on clarity, accountability and reliable API integration.
highlights: Case workflow: structured the management and retrieval of court records and case information to streamline day-to-day administration.
Decision support: organized case details for review by authorized personnel while preserving human responsibility for judicial decisions.
API engineering: developed Laravel-based RESTful services and GraphQL interfaces for flexible, structured data access.
Swagger & testing: incorporated Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and API testing practices to improve integration clarity and maintainability.
Accessible interfaces: built responsive Vue.js screens to help staff navigate records and workflows.
Security-minded design: emphasized authenticated access, role-aware workflows, input validation and dependable handling of sensitive information.
